Subject: Vendor provisioning: buyer intake checklist & remit/ACH info

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the inference layer on Hemera's new analytics product. To get procurement and billing set up on our side we need a short packet of vendor data from you. Please see the checklist below and attach the documents where noted. If anything is sensitive you can send them to vendor-ops@redwood.com or upload to the secure link (see HubSpot record) — we prefer encrypted PDFs.

Required items (buyer intake + vendor setup):
- Legal entity name (exact as tax filings) and any DBAs
- Registered address and remit-to address (if different)
- Tax ID / VAT number and completed W-9 (United States) or W-8/W-9 equivalent
- ACH details: bank name, routing number, account number, account holder name, account type (checking/savings) — or wire instructions if you prefer wires
- Primary AP contact name, email, and phone number
- Preferred invoicing email and PO process (do you require a PO number on every invoice?)
- W-9 (attachment) or VAT certificate (attachment)

Notes on timing: once we have the completed intake + W-9/W-8 and either ACH/wire file we can provision Hemera as an approved vendor in our AP system. Typical lead time: 5–7 business days for onboarding and 1 invoice cycle to begin payments.

Attachments: Redwood_Buyer_Intake_Form.pdf (fillable) — please fill and return.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm who will complete the intake and the expected delivery date?
2) If you require a PO, please confirm standard PO terms and whether a procurement contact should be copied on invoices.

Thanks — feel free to ping me if you want to walk through the form live.

--
Rachel Kim
Senior Procurement Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
